items.description: Reinstated S Jalen Thompson from injured reserve. Elevated RB Jashaun Corbin from the practice squad to the active roster.
Placed RB J.K. Dobbins on the reserve/suspended list. Signed DT Khalen Saunders to the practice squad.
Placed DL Skyler Gill-Howard on injured reserve. Elevated DE Anthony Lucas from the practice squad to the active roster.
Designated CB Cam Taylor-Britt to return from injured reserve.
Reinstated OL Justin Dedich and DL Kobie Turner from injured reserve.
Signed P Jack Browning from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed DE Max Llewellyn to the practice squad.
Elevated LB Mason Reiger and DB Cole Wisniewski from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed DT Gabe Hall from the practice squad to the active roster.
Released QB Aaron Rodgers.

Reinstated CB Nate Hobbs from injured reserve. Signed WR Brandin Cooks to the practice squad. Placed RT Colton McKivitz on injured reserve. Designated OL Austen Pleasants to return from injured reserve.
Designated WR Jalen McMillan and LB Christian Rozeboom to return from injured reserve. Signed CB Brandon Johnson to the practice squad.
Agreed to terms with WR Brandon Aiyuk on a practice squad contract.
Designated OLB Thomas Incoom to return from injured reserve.
Designated OL Patrick Mekari to return from injured reserve.
Signed DT Junior Tafuna and WR Daniel Sobkowicz to the practice squad. Released RB Dare Ogunbowale.
Signed G Nick Broeker to the practice squad.
Claimed DB Isaac Yiadom off waivers from Washington.
Designated RB Raheim Sanders to return from injured reserve.
Suspended RB J.K. Dobbins one game for conduct detrimental to the team. Designated RB Tyler Badie to return from injured reserve.
Reinstated DE Micah Parsons from the physically unable to perform list.
Waived LB Milo Eifler from injured reserve. Signed DB Derrick Canteen to the practice squad. Released LB Dominique Hampton from the practice squad.

Waived T Charlie Heck. Signed QB Shane Buechele from Buffalo's practice squad and DE Carl Lawson from the practice squad to the active roster. Placed DE Caden Curry on injured reserve. Signed TE Sean McKeon and DE Cam Sample to the practice squad.
Placed FB Ben VanSumeren on injured reserve. Signed OT Fred Johnson from the practice squad to the active roster.
Signed DT David Blay and DB A.J. Woods to the practice squad. Released T Amari Kight and DB Greedy Vance from the practice squad.
Designated LB Ronnie Harrison to return from injured reserve.
Signed T Tristan Leigh to the practice squad. Released LB Josh Ross from the practice squad.
